name: Tekscend Photomask Corp.
summary: Tekscend Photomask Corp. makes semiconductor photomasks and sells them in Japan and internationally. Its range covers EUV, binary, stencil and phase shift masks, 3D gray-tone masks, silicon stencil masks and molds for nanoimprint, and glass masks for research and development. Formerly Toppan Photomask Co., Ltd., it took its present name in October 2024, dates from 2021 and has its base in Minato, Japan.
